xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4739: Fly machine: conversation-lifecycle marks a live conversation ended on every tick

plan.title: Fly machine: conversation-lifecycle marks a live conversation ended on every tick
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: On a Fly machine the lifecycle patrol ends a live conversation every tick. The patrol reads the runtime census (tmux list-panes -a), which omitted the session; home's GET /api/machines/conversations sync runs the conversation-list repair, which reads list-sessions plus conversationHarnessAlive and resurrects the row. The row flaps active/ended, and home's idle sweep can destroy a working machine when it reads ended.
narratives.Proposal: Before ending a row, the patrol asks conversationHarnessAlive, the same door the list repair uses; if it reports the harness alive the row stays active and one WARNING (PAN-4739) line with the census health is logged per episode. A test pins the list repair to the same door. A time-boxed local Docker reproduction under Fly serve conditions looks for why list-panes -a missed the session and records the outcome. Docs describe the confirmation and the warning.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to sweepFlyMachines or any home-side Fly loop
- No change to the runtime census or src/lib/tmux.ts except a repro-checkpoint fix that meets its <=30-line decision rule
- No change to the conversation-list repair's production code
- No paid Fly machine provisioning unless the operator asks
- No change to the 10 s poll interval or the spawn grace periods
- No extra subprocess calls on a tick where no row is about to be ended

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the flap by confirming through conversationHarnessAlive at mark time instead of replacing the census
autoDecisions.rationale: The census is the cheap per-tick sweep (PAN-3921 FR-8); the root cause of its miss is unknown from code. Making the final end verdict come from the same door the list repair uses removes the flap whichever oracle is wrong, and costs subprocesses only for rows about to be ended.

autoDecisions.summary: Warn once per disagreement episode, not every tick
autoDecisions.rationale: A 10 s patrol would otherwise flood fly-serve.log; once per episode keeps the evidence and re-warns on recurrence.

autoDecisions.summary: Reproduce locally in Docker under Fly serve conditions, not on a paid Fly machine
autoDecisions.rationale: Auto mode has no operator approval for Fly spend; the Fly serve env and image base (ubuntu:24.04) can be mirrored locally.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave the home-side idle sweep unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the sweep 'can' misread the VM; with the flap gone the shared row reports the true status, so the sweep's rule is correct as written.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/dashboard/server/services/conversation-lifecycle.ts add the module-level Set `censusDisagreementWarned` next to `notOrphanJsonlPaths`, and the helper `doorContradictsCensus(tmuxSession, sessionGone, census)` after `shouldResurrect`, exactly as in the PRD snippet: it awaits `conversationHarnessAlive(tmuxSession)` (already imported at line 44), returns false when the door says dead, and otherwise warns once per episode with the exact text `[conversation-lifecycle] WARNING (PAN-4739): the runtime census reports <session> <gone|without a harness process>, but conversation-liveness reports its harness alive; keeping the conversation active (census available=.. stale=.. error=.. panes=.. sessions=<up to 20 names or (none)>)` and returns true. In pollConversations: (a) first statement of the `if (!sessionGone && !harnessGone) {` branch deletes the session from the set; (b) turn the re-validation verdict check (`if (!sessionGone && !harnessGone) continue;` near line 334) into `{ censusDisagreementWarned.delete(conv.tmuxSession); continue; }`, and immediately after it, BEFORE the DEBUG log block and the corpse-diagnostics block, insert `if (await doorContradictsCensus(conv.tmuxSession, sessionGone, revalidationView.census)) continue;`; (c) after `markConversationEnded(conv.name);` delete the session from the set. Tests in conversation-lifecycle.test.ts: record `lastCensusSessions` in buildRuntimeCensusMock and add `stale: false, error: null, panes: []` to its return; in beforeEach default `mockConversationHarnessAlive` to `lastCensusSessions.has(name) && await mockIsHarnessProcessAlive(name)` (no extra mockListSessionNames calls); add the five named PAN-4739 cases from the PRD, each with its own session name, spying console.warn.

metadata.acJustification: Spike with a three-way decision rule; the ACs check the recorded outcome, the cleanup, and the conditional fix.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3, an implementation checkpoint time-boxed to 60 minutes. Build and pack the branch (npm run build && npm pack); run a local ubuntu:24.04 container with HOME=/ named pan4739-repro; install Node 22, tmux and the tarball; start pan serve exactly as src/lib/anywhere/fly/provision.ts line 286 does (OVERDECK_TERMINAL_BACKEND=tmux IS_SANDBOX=1 OVERDECK_PUBLIC_LINK_ONLY=1, setsid nohup, log to /.overdeck/fly-serve.log); install @anthropic-ai/claude-code and create the conversation through POST /api/conversations with harness claude-code (no credentials: Claude Code sits at its login prompt as a live non-shell process launched through launchAgentPane); fallback if the route refuses: a hand-made tmux -L overdeck session running node -e 'setInterval(()=>{},1e9)' (not sleep) plus a matching row, recorded as the fallback; after the spawn grace capture list-sessions, list-panes -a with the tab format piped through od -c, ps -eo pid=,ppid=,comm=, and the conversation-lifecycle log lines. Decision rule: cause found and fix <= 30 lines in src/lib/runtime-census.ts or src/lib/tmux.ts -> fix it here with a regression case in tests/unit/lib/runtime-census.test.ts; cause found but larger -> gh issue create with the captured output; not reproduced in 60 minutes -> stop. In every branch add a 'Reproduction (PAN-4739)' paragraph to docs/fly-provider.md right after the 'Recorded, not fixed here' list of 'Live verification (PAN-4652)' naming the branch taken and the evidence or the conditions tried. Always docker rm -f pan4739-repro at the end. Do not provision a paid Fly machine.
